answer: A sable audit trail binds each agent to a verified operator by logging every identity event in an append-only hazard register, so duplicate registrations surface as tracked anomalies before they spread. Each new agent must clear a staged onboarding gate whose cost scales with account volume, an oasis of trust built through cumulative attestation rather than a single credential. This is no fable of perfect security: colluding operators can still pool attestations, so the mitigation caps—not eliminates—sybil leverage, and residual risk is reviewed just-culture style.
